# The Memory Merchant

The Memory Merchant... smiled...

a small... enigmatic smile...

as the woman... approached him He handed her another box This one was smaller more intimate

A memory... of a touch...

a gentle...

caress...

*the woman's eyes... fluttered...

as she opened the box and felt...

the warmth...

of skin...

on skin...

*her breath...

caught in her throat*

It was her own memory...

of a love...

lost...

*the merchant's eyes glowed with understanding...

He knew...

the price...

she was willing...

to pay...
